name: Content Filter: Grief and bereavement
description: Keeps "grief and bereavement" out of the new island events. Applied before the rare roll picks an event: an outcome with that content is dropped where the event still makes sense without it (the other outcomes keep their shares), otherwise the whole event is skipped. Filters never hide a kind of person. New events only; the game's own events are unchanged. Off by default, Owner's Defaults too. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.**

needs_on.for: the new island events it acts on

behavior_changes: Every new event's outcomes tagged F05 are left out of its draw while this row is installed, and an event that cannot do without them is skipped (its requirement).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte, game file or save is changed: the row is only a name in the installed patches' list ("VVFP Installed Patches.txt") that Story / Cheat Upgrades reads.
The game's own island events, their text and their chances are never changed: it acts on the added events only.
evidence_status: the compiled events' conditions and effects pinned in tests/test_event_content.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
